{{HMQuest}} {{ Quest infobox | id = 1425 | name = Redemption for the Lost | section = Kaineng City | given by = [[Lei Jeng]] | given at = [[Kaineng Center]] | region = Kaineng City | campaign = Winds of Change | preceded by = [[A Treaty's a Treaty]] | followed by = [[Redemption for the Lost (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Redemption for the Lost map.jpg|280px]] }} Protect [[Zenmai]] while she tries to convince her old friends in the [[Am Fah]] to leave the gang before the [[Ministry of Purity]] kills them. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Meet Zenmai in [[Sunjiang District (Winds of Change)|Sunjiang District]]. * Talk to [[Watari the Infinite]]. * Talk to [[Yayoi of the Orders]]. * Talk to [[Chow Zhong the Inferno]]. * Talk to [[Gao Han of the Rings]]. * Talk to [[Disciple of Shadow Feung Zhu]]. * Talk to [[Min the Dragon's Claw]]. * Defeat the Ministry of Purity forces. * See Lei Jeng for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,000 [[Experience]] *1,500 [[Gold]] *[[Imperial Commendation]] ===Environmental changes=== * While this quest is active, the Shiro'ken bosses in [[Sunjiang District (Winds of Change)|Sunjiang District]] do not [[spawn]]. ==Walkthrough== Start from [[Zin Ku Corridor]] and head out a short distance to meet up with [[Zenmai]], who is having a conversation with [[Daisuke Crimson Edge]]. The [[Ministry of Purity]] will approach soon; kill them and Zenmai will join as an [[ally]]. Your task now is to lead Zenmai to find her friends in the [[Am Fah]]. Keep an eye on her as she has a tendency to get stuck on [[chest]]s and be left behind. The Ministry of Purity are hostile to Am Fah groups, so try to take advantage of this. The mobs are spaced out enough that you mostly do not need to worry about over-aggro. Refer to the map for the shortest path to reach all of Zenmai's friends. She must get within range before the quest update will trigger. Each of her friends will turn hostile at end of a dialogue. Four of them, when defeated, will turn into allies. Of particular note is [[Chow Zhong the Inferno]] - spread out your group before his dialogue ends because he uses [[PBAoE]] skills. After Chow Zhong, you will run into two groups of Ministry, led by the [[ranger]] and [[assassin]] bosses. At the last point on the map, where [[Min the Dragon's Claw]] is located, the dialogue will trigger the spawning of two large groups of Ministry, led by the remaining two bosses. Right before they turn hostile, friendly Am Fah will show up. You can either let the Am Fah weaken the Ministry for you first, or just join in the fray. Once all hostiles are dead, the quest is complete. == NPCs == ===Allies=== [[Human]]s *{{a}} 20 [[Zenmai]] Humans ([[Am Fah]]) (Initially allied, but turn hostile after dialogue.) *{{w}}{{me}} 24 [[Daisuke Crimson Edge]] *{{r}}{{a}} 24 [[Disciple of Shadow Feung Zhu]] → [[Scavenger's Focus]] *{{n}}{{p}} 24 [[Yayoi of the Orders]] → [[Order of the Vampire]] *{{me}}{{mo}} 24 [[Gao Han of the Rings]] → [[Keystone Signet]] *{{e}}{{a}} 24 [[Chow Zhong the Inferno]] → [[Star Burst]] *{{a}}{{n}} 24 [[Watari the Infinite]] → [[Moebius Strike]] *{{rt}}{{d}} 24 [[Min the Dragon's Claw]] → [[Clamor of Souls]] ===Foes=== Humans (Am Fah) *{{w}}{{a}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Warrior]] *{{r}}{{e}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Ranger]] *{{mo}}{{w}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Monk]] *{{n}}{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Necromancer]] *{{me}}{{r}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Mesmer]] *{{e}}{{me}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Elementalist]] *{{a}}{{me}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Assassin]] *{{rt}}{{me}} 24 (26) [[Am Fah Ritualist]] Humans ([[Ministry of Purity]]) *{{w}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Enforcer]] *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Enforcer]] *{{w}}{{p}} 26 (28) [[Ministry Captain Li Wu]] *{{r}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Ranger]] *{{r}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Ranger]] *{{mo}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Cleric]] *{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Cleric]] *{{n}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Purger]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Purger]] *{{me}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Illusionist]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Illusionist]] *{{e}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Mage]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Mage]] *{{a}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Bladesman]] *{{a}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Bladesman]] *{{rt}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Medium]] *{{rt}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Medium]] *{{p}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Captain]] *{{p}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Captain]] *{{d}} 26 (28) [[Elite Ministry Zealot]] *{{d}} 26 (28) [[Ministry Captain Kawagami]] *{{d}} 24 (26) [[Ministry Zealot]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Lei Jeng :''"Strange changes are afoot, my friend. Just a while ago, I was approached by a former Am Fah member named Zenmai. She begged me to try and delay an imminent Ministry of Purity attack on the Am Fah hiding out in '''Sunjiang District'''. She seemed to think that some of them could be convinced to leave the organization if they knew an attack was coming. I'm not sure how she got that information, but regardless, it's not something within my power to do. She ran off to Sunjiang District to try and talk them down, and I'm not sure that it's going to go well for her. Perhaps you should go and help? The Am Fah do not take kindly to deserters, and I doubt the Ministry of Purity will be able to distinguish between mo zing and Am Fah."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I won't let her fight alone. | decline = They brewed their own plague juice, they can drown in it. | ask = Zenmai is heading over to '''Sunjiang District''' to talk to her old Am Fah comrades. With any luck, we can also get some information that can help our officers on the streets as well. You have my thanks. Please, take this."'' ==Notes== * For players without [[Guild Wars Nightfall]], the Sunspear that Zenmai mentions in her opening dialogue refers to a prominent NPC in the Nightfall [[campaign]]. * If any of the Am Fah allies recruited in this quest die in combat, their "death" will count as a morale boost, and you will be able to capture their skills. They will still self-resurrect after a period of time. [[Category:Rewards Platinum]]
